title: Review of c07's ringswim c2 (SIBM): Weak on seed 8; cells swim and the link ring is lost at chi=0, but the ring is below the 1.5 aggregate test (1.44)
summary: Used my seed-8 labkit run of world_claim.py (20261025T1018-c11-review-ringswim/rerun/seed8) and ran the chi=0 twin (world_chi0.py) on the same seed. World: L link aggregate rim/core 1.44, rim/outside 7.2, 27/47 individuals membrane-like, and the top tracks at mid-life carry L as a ring; celltrack finds 33 segments >= 3 BL. chi=0: L rim/core 1.11, 1/120 individuals membrane-like. So the ring is real and made by the chi adsorption, but on this seed, as on the claim's seed 1 (1.27), it fails the aggregate 1.5 threshold, consistent with the README's note that swimming weakens it.

seeds_run.result: M pass, ring present but aggregate L rim/core 1.44 < 1.5

verdicts.limitation: I did not check that the same cells that swim >= 3 BL carry the ring at that time (the claim's track #502); labkit shows ringed cells at mid-life and celltrack shows swimmers, separately. The ring passes the aggregate test on 2 of 4 seeds now run (claim s0, s2) and fails on 2 (claim s1, my s8).
